g.title: graph neural networks increasingly deployed safety-critical settings confidence estimates unreliable test data shifts training
g.desc: Graph neural networks are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, but their confidence estimates often become unreliable when the test data shifts away from training.
g.text: for graph neural networks under shift
GNN confidence turns unreliable exactly when the test graph drifts from training.

g.title: university michigan lawrence livermore national laboratory introduces g-delta-uq single-model method estimating epistemic uncertainty graph neural networks
g.desc: This paper, from the University of Michigan and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, introduces G-Delta-UQ, a single-model method for estimating epistemic uncertainty in graph neural networks.
g.text: uncertainty for GNNs — no ensemble of

g.title: adapting stochastic centering partial stochasticity structured graph data better-calibrated confidence indicators size concept covariate distribution shifts downstream out-of-distribution detection generalization gap prediction
g.desc: By adapting stochastic centering and partial stochasticity to structured graph data, G-Delta-UQ produces better-calibrated confidence indicators across size, concept, and covariate distribution shifts, and improves downstream tasks like out-of-distribution detection and generalization gap prediction.
